[SWS_FrTrcv_00374] ⌈The function FrTrcv_CheckWakeupByTransceiver() shall clear
a pending wake up event on the transceiver identified by FrTrcv_TrcvIdx after the last
call of EcuM (EcuM_SetWakeupEvent). Wake up by bus is always asynchronous to
the transition to sleep and standby. In worst case wake up occurs during transition to
sleep.⌋
